verdicts.reason: The two layouts are the same and share the same flaws. The white logo bar stops at about two-thirds of the width, leaving an odd navy strip at the top. The orange divider floats alone above the CTA in the right column. The body copy sits off-centre from the headline, is jammed right under it and nearly touches the bottom edge. The right column is mostly empty. The only difference is the logo: B's is slightly larger and closer to the original's proportion, while A's is shrunk.
